purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: GSM8K (Grade School Math 8K)
candidates.notes: 8.5k multi-step word problems with step-by-step solutions. Card: MIT. train 7473 / test 1319. Core WSTU reasoning resource.

candidates.name: GSM8K-Platinum
candidates.notes: Human-verified corrected GSM8K test subset. Use as a contamination-safe math evaluation.

candidates.name: MATH (Hendrycks)
candidates.notes: 12.5k competition problems with full LaTeX solutions across 7 subjects. Strong reasoning + final-answer format.

candidates.name: Competition Math (mirror)
candidates.notes: Community mirror of Hendrycks MATH. High cross-dataset duplicate risk vs EleutherAI/hendrycks_math - dedup required.

candidates.name: MATH-500
candidates.notes: 500-problem subset of MATH used for LLM leaderboard evaluation. Benchmark => evaluation_only.

candidates.name: DeepMind Mathematics Dataset
candidates.notes: Programmatically generated symbolic math modules (millions of items). data_origin=synthetic; answer is deterministic so answer validation is exact.

candidates.name: AQuA-RAT
candidates.notes: ~100k algebraic word problems with 5 choices + rationales. Exactly matches WSTU MCQ+reasoning format.

candidates.name: SVAMP
candidates.notes: 1k varied elementary math problems; short equation + numeric answer. Excellent compact reasoning eval/train.

candidates.name: ASDiv
candidates.notes: 2.3k diverse MWPs with formula annotations. Numeric final answer => deterministic validation.

candidates.name: MathQA
candidates.notes: ~37k AQuA-style MC problems with operation programs. 5-choice format fits WSTU directly.
